# OpenClaw Pulse - AI-SEO Documentation

## Project Overview

OpenClaw Pulse is a high-performance, autonomous system monitoring dashboard for OpenClaw, an AI agent orchestration framework. It provides real-time token tracking, model analytics, and usage breakdown across multiple AI providers.

## Privacy-First Architecture

The dashboard is designed with privacy as the core principle:
- Reads local OpenClaw logs from `~/.openclaw/logs`
- Extracts only numerical usage data (tokens, timestamps, model names)
- Never exposes raw message content, system prompts, or user identifiers
- Safe for public deployment since no sensitive data leaves the local environment

## Key Features

- **Real-time Token Tracking**: Monitor input, output, and cache savings across all providers
- **Model Analytics**: Breakdown of usage by model (Gemini, Llama, Claude, GPT, etc.)
- **Provider Metrics**: Track costs and usage per AI provider
- **Privacy-First Design**: Local log processing only

## Technology Stack

- Next.js 15 (React 19)
- Tailwind CSS 4
- Recharts for data visualization
- TypeScript
- Jest for testing

## Integration Points

The dashboard reads from local OpenClaw log files in JSON format. The API endpoint `/api/stats` parses these logs and returns aggregated statistics. Log files should be placed in `~/.openclaw/logs/` directory.

## Use Cases

- Monitor AI agent token consumption
- Track cost efficiency across providers
- Analyze model adoption patterns
- Identify usage trends over time
- Build usage dashboards for AI infrastructure

## Related Projects

- [OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) - AI agent orchestration framework
- [@opensourceframework](https://github.com/riceharvest/opensourceframework) - Ecosystem

## Configuration

No API keys required. The dashboard automatically discovers logs from the local filesystem. Configure the log directory by ensuring OpenClaw writes to `~/.openclaw/logs/`.

## Security Considerations

- All processing happens locally
- No data transmitted to external services
- Frontend receives only aggregated metrics
- Suitable for air-gapped environments
